provenance: Authored by the agent on 2026-09-26 and frozen before any prediction with these inputs. Translations simulate the intended pipeline in which the calling agent rewrites a query in the knowledge language before retrieval; they are faithful renderings, keep identifiers verbatim and were not tuned against corpus vocabulary, but the author had already seen the corpus and the first diagnostics. In-domain negatives are plausible KnowledgeRail questions whose answer is absent from the 59-page corpus at a5d5e185c41625fbc955340a7d390d5e95fbcb93; their key terms were screened by exact search over the page bodies. Questions answerable by an explicit 'not available' statement were excluded. No independent human adjudication.
